verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management platform, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or where data is hosted. Additional Workspaces for sandboxing and separating sensitive work are an adjacent feature, not a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
